# Fonts

**These files are copies. Do not edit them here.**

`kalulu_mulish_regular.otf`, `kalulu_mulish_bold.otf`, `kalulu_mulish_black.otf`
and `OFL.txt` are byte-identical copies of the reference fonts in
[Kalulu-Languages](https://github.com/Excello-Recherche-Education/Kalulu-Languages),
folder [`fonts/mulish/`](https://github.com/Excello-Recherche-Education/Kalulu-Languages/tree/main/fonts/mulish),
where the language packs and the printed reading booklets take them from too.
To change a font, change it there first, then copy the files here.

This Mulish is a version modified for Kalulu: its capital `I` has serifs, so a
child cannot mistake it for a lowercase `l`, and its `t` rests on the baseline.
It is under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`), not under this
repository's CC BY-SA license. What was changed, and the copyright notices, are
in [`fonts/LICENSE.md`](https://github.com/Excello-Recherche-Education/Kalulu-Languages/blob/main/fonts/LICENSE.md).
